card.name: Dose-frequency and amount nouns
card.fires_on: Nouns or adverbs that complete a quantity or frequency phrase, such as dose, doses, times, frequently and rate, right after words like additional, two, three or infusion. Mostly found in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Dose after additional or number
modes.description: The word dose or doses after a count or 'additional' in missed-dose or vomiting instructions.
modes.example: Do not take an additional<< dose>> if vomiting occurs after taking FRUZA

modes.label: Frequency or rate wording
modes.description: Words like times, frequently or rate that finish a how-often or how-fast phrase.
modes.example: Suggested dosage is 10 mg three<< times>> daily, for a period of at least

modes.label: Non-drug payment phrases
modes.description: Words like each or contributions in money or funding phrases outside medicine.
modes.example: fifty dollars a year for<< each>> gas well, as long as it was
